hubs.state: The ley line under Monroe Park ran off-tempo for the fourth time in seven weeks, now detected by unofficial instruments. Dr. Olave's closed meetings continue, and the engineered Awakening program remains secret.
hubs.condition: Consilium fracture widening; Olave's closed meetings have grown more exclusive and a second, smaller meeting now convenes; Ingrid Voss's archival inquiries have reached restricted Special Collections material. Junior faculty and Consilium members are tracking who is no longer invited.

hubs.note: Increased supernatural activity near the warehouse; Petra Holt's principals are now active in the area.
Increased hunter network activity near The Exchange.
hubs.condition: Night-shift unease at The Exchange has sharpened: a mortal medium has begun waiting through the late shift and leaving offerings at a second Downtown location, and staff continue to log unlogged traffic no known network claims.

Temporal displacement continues to surface through ordinary institutional routines. The East End Family Resource Center's pantry intake keeps logging names and vouchers that don't match current RRHA records, and Sister Catherine Burke's separate ledger for them has grown as she cross-checks the entries against older parish records.
rumors: A fae noble is offering a reward for a stolen egg nobody will describe.
Somebody at the free clinic heals by touch, but only after dark.
A lowrider on Nine Mile has been seen driving itself.
A hunter is asking around for an apprentice who knows the block.
The Midnight Truck has started stopping at a house it never stopped at before.
A psychic on the tenant council blames a Night crew for the missing kids' dreams.
A grave in Hollywood shows a burial date for someone still alive.
The War Memorial's wall has a new name every morning.
Someone is buying the old cemetery deeds.
A Night elder wants Gambles Hill declared neutral ground.
A martyr's family says he came home.
A Power broker pays well for forgotten names.
There's a fight club for things that aren't human under the Commerce Road yards.
The crew that salvaged a wreck at Warwick hasn't come back up.
Boat fires on the south bank are being blamed on the Wild.
A reporter is asking dock crews about Night money.
An ex-Power leader was seen meeting Night enforcers at Rocketts.
A street preacher on the Mayo Bridge promises the river will 'reform' the city.
A ghost cook in a soup line feeds people memories they never had.
A mural under the viaduct weeps ash when Night business is done nearby.
Power people are offering a bed to anyone who has had a particular dream.
Something fae is trapped in the last payphone on the strip.
A free clinic is trading Debts for supplies.
Pills cut with something that glows are going around.
